title: O Father, All Creating
description: O Father, All Creating in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 4 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by John Ellerton, first published in 1876. The tune, AURELIA, is by Samuel Sebastian Wesley (1864). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: O Fa-ther, all cre-a-ting, Whose wis-dom, love, and pow'r First bound two lives to-ge-ther In E-den's pri-mal hour, To-day to these Thy child-ren Thy ear-liest gifts re-new: A home by Thee made hap-py, A love by Thee kept true.

lines: A home by Thee made happy,
A love by Thee kept true.
With these who call on Thee;
And teach them, in the tasting
To know the gift is Thine.
From sin and strife kept free,
Their lives may own Thy guidance,
Their hearts be rul'd by Thee.
The house is built in vain;
The joy will turn to pain;
But naught can break the union
Of hearts in Thee made one,
